text.title: 磁板上的原子核
text.situation:
讲解员为下一模型选择碳原子。标为质子和中子的磁块放在原子核中，电子标签在外面。这是简化教学模型，不是照片，也不是粒子精确位置图。板边电子计数器在游客按键时响应。远端元素周期表按原子序数排列元素。乔数碳模型的质子标签，再到表上找对应数字。玛雅拍下板子，没有移动模型部件。

乔：电子是原子核的一部分吗？
讲解员：在这个原子里，电子在原子核外。
玛雅：为什么选碳？
讲解员：这个熟悉的例子方便比较模型和元素周期表。

paragraphs.en: The guide chose a carbon atom for the next model. Magnets marked proton and neutron sat in the nucleus, while electron labels belonged outside it. The arrangement was a simple teaching model, not a photograph or a map of exact particle positions. An electronic counter beside the board responded when a visitor pressed a button. At the far end, the periodic table arranged the elements by atomic number. Jo counted the proton labels in the carbon model and found the corresponding number on the table. Maya photographed the board rather than moving any of its pieces.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Is an electron part of the nucleus?
Guide: In this atom, electrons are outside the nucleus.
Maya: Why carbon?
Guide: It gives us a familiar example for comparing the model and the periodic table.

S04.G06.P01.function: A nucleus on a magnet board
acceptableAnswers: 质子标签放在模型的原子核中。 中子标签在质子标签旁。 碳模型中心有原子核。

S04.G06.P02.function: A nucleus on a magnet board
acceptableAnswers: 电子标签在原子核外。 模型没有展示粒子的精确位置。

S04.G06.P03.function: A nucleus on a magnet board
acceptableAnswers: 电子计数器响应按键。 乔在元素周期表上找到碳。
